requirements_summary: Workloads: live agent assist (low-latency), ticket summarization for record creation, automated tool-calling into CRM and internal ticketing systems.
Latency target: p95 <= 200ms for short-agent-turn tokens, p95 <= 600ms for multi-step tool-calling flows.
Throughput target: baseline 1,200 concurrent sessions, daily token volume ~150M; expected promotional spikes up to 5x baseline for 6-12 hour windows.
Reliability: 99.9% uptime target, graceful degradation to lower-cost fallback models on contention, guaranteed audit trail for all model calls.
Model preferences: prefer vetted open models or Redwood-verified variants; deterministic reranking + hallucination detection for ticket edits.
Tooling: function/tool-calling with strong idempotency guarantees, native SDK hooks for CRM update actions, end-to-end tracing required.
Retention & residency: configurable retention controls per workload; PHI must never leave customer VPC; data residency enforced in us-east-1.
Security: full SAML SSO with custom attributes, KMS integration for key management, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence required for procurement.
Compliance: must satisfy PCI DSS for payment auth flows and HIPAA for clinical notes; maintain immutable audit logs for six years for certain flows.
